::: {.lead}
Everything you write on the week pages collects here, grouped by session.
:::

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
## Keep a copy

These notes live in this browser only. They are never sent anywhere — which also means
nothing can restore them. Clearing your browser data deletes them, they do not follow you to
another device, and **iOS Safari can discard them after about a week without a visit**.

Export them regularly. It takes one click.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="notes-toolbar">
  <button type="button" id="export-md" class="btn-slides primary">Download as Markdown</button>
  <button type="button" id="export-json" class="btn-slides">Download as JSON</button>
  <label for="import-json" class="btn-slides">Restore from JSON</label>
  <input type="file" id="import-json" accept="application/json,.json"
         style="position:absolute;left:-9999px;opacity:0">
  <button type="button" id="clear-notes" class="btn-slides danger">Delete all</button>
</div>

<p class="notes-count" id="notes-count"></p>
<p class="form-status" id="import-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>

<div id="all-notes" class="paragraph-notes">
  <p class="note-empty">Loading…</p>
</div>
```

::: {.source-note}
Markdown is the readable format — open it in any notes app or print it. JSON is the one to keep
if you want to restore these notes into another browser later.
:::
